exceptions.scope: Reached through biscuit-auth 6.0.0 in the om-token gateway capability-token runtime and the optional token benchmark.
exceptions.reason: Crates.io still publishes biscuit-auth 6.0.0, which unconditionally depends on P256. cargo update cannot move crypto-bigint past the elliptic-curve 0.13 constraint; the newer upstream source is not a released crate.
exceptions.remediation: Before expiry, upgrade to a released Biscuit version that removes or gates the affected P256 dependency, or replace the dependency; rerun cargo audit and remove this exception when clear.
